notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
We have new next-gen update rebuilt for Unreal 5.4. We fixed some bugs, added some additional help and the function to adjust the brightness of the environment.

OBS
It is important to emphasize that if you have played the previous Pombero game and now want to play this one, you must uninstall the previous game and delete your games because it could generate conflicts with this new remastered version. The game games are hosted in C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\Pombero, where the Pombero folder must be deleted in order to create a new series of variables for the remaster version.
